PAGASA raised a fresh orange rainfall warning over Bataan, Zambales, Cavite, Batangas, and Laguna at 2 p.m. Thursday, July 24, as the enhanced southwest monsoon and Typhoon #EmongPH continued to drench Luzon.

A yellow warning remains over Metro Manila, Rizal, Quezon, Bulacan, Pampanga, and Tarlac, with flooding possible in low-lying areas.

JUST IN: Rep. Martin Romualdez requests the Office of the Secretary General to "tone down" SONA ceremonies — particularly the red carpet, where officials often turn up in elaborate Filipino attire likened to a fashion show.

This comes as twin cyclones, Typhoon Emong and Tropical Storm Dante, and the southwest monsoon batter the Philippines with fierce winds, heavy rainfall, and widespread flooding.

"It would be out of touch to maintain a show of pageantry while our people are still in recovery," he said in a statement.

"The opening of Congress is not a fashion event, it is a working session. Let’s begin it with the seriousness and humility our times demand," he added.
